description:
Create a digital sewing pattern for a canvas tote bag in LibreCAD. 

1. Create three layers: 'STITCH_LINE' (White/7), 'SEAM_ALLOWANCE' (Red/1), and 'FOLD_LINE' (Cyan/4).
2. On the 'STITCH_LINE' layer, draw the bag body: a rectangle 350mm wide x 400mm high. Position the bottom-left corner at (100, 100).
3. Apply a 30mm chamfer to the two bottom corners of the bag body.
4. On the 'SEAM_ALLOWANCE' layer, create a 15mm offset outside the entire bag body shape.
5. On the 'FOLD_LINE' layer, draw a horizontal line representing the hem, 40mm down from the top edge of the finished body.
6. Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/tote_bag_pattern.dxf'.
